+# ─── Deploy CIAM Tenant ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+# Wave 1 of the B2C → CIAM migration: provision Entra External ID (CIAM) tenant
+# at subscription scope via Microsoft.AzureActiveDirectory/ciamDirectories.
+#
+# Prerequisites:
+#   - OIDC federated credential configured (azure/login@v2, no client secret)
+#   - Repository secrets: AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
+#   - Repository variables: AZURE_LOCATION (e.g. eastus2), ENVIRONMENT (e.g. dev)
+#   - Key Vault (wawkr-kv-<env>) must exist to store CIAM outputs
+#
+# Refs: issue #166 (Wave 1 IaC), issue #165 (B2C → CIAM epic)
+# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+name: Deploy CIAM Tenant
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+    paths:
+      - 'iac/ciam/**'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      environment:
+        description: 'Target environment'
+        required: true
+        default: 'dev'
+        type: choice
+        options: [dev, staging, prod]
+      tenant_name:
+        description: 'CIAM tenant subdomain (e.g. pawzum)'
+        required: false
+        default: 'pawzum'
+      sku_name:
+        description: 'SKU tier'
+        required: false
+        default: 'Standard'
+        type: choice
+        options: [Standard, PremiumP1, PremiumP2]
+
+# Deployment jobs must never be cancelled mid-flight (governance guardrail).
+concurrency:
+  group: deploy-ciam-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  validate:
+    name: Validate Bicep
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
+
+      - name: Build Bicep (lint + compile)
+        run: az bicep build --file iac/ciam/ciam-main.bicep
+
+  deploy:

## Unused variable, import, function or class Unused import beforeEach. --- The fix is to remove the unused named import beforeEach from the vitest import list, while keeping the rest of the import unchanged.

**Best minimal fix (no behavior change):**

  • Edit apps/web/src/__tests__/oauth-registration-matrix.test.ts at line 1.
  • Change:
    • import { describe, expect, it, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
  • To:
    • import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

No additional methods, definitions, or external dependencies are required.

## Unused variable, import, function or class Unused import resolveFirstNonEmptyEnv. --- The correct fix is to remove the unused named import from apps/web/src/auth.ts while preserving all existing runtime behavior. Since imports that are not referenced do not affect program behavior (other than lint/build noise), deleting only the unused specifier is the safest no-functional-change fix.

In this case, update the import section at the top of apps/web/src/auth.ts and delete:

  • import { resolveFirstNonEmptyEnv } from '@/lib/auth-provider-env';

No additional methods, definitions, or dependency changes are required.

## Unused variable, import, function or class Unused variable connectionString. --- The general fix for unused-variable findings is to either (a) remove the variable if it is not needed, or (b) wire it into the logic if it is required by behavior.
Here, the best no-functional-change fix is to delete the unused connectionString declaration in apps/web/src/auth.ts inside the email provider’s instantiate function.

Specific edit:

  • In apps/web/src/auth.ts, around lines 237–240 in the shown snippet, remove:
    • const connectionString = creds.clientId; // Reusing clientId field for connection string
  • Keep the remaining emailFromAddress assignment and Resend({...}) logic unchanged.

No imports, methods, or additional definitions are required.

## Unused variable, import, function or class Unused variable connectionString. ---

The best fix is to remove the unused local variable declaration for connectionString in apps/web/src/auth.ts within the email provider instantiate callback.

  • **General approach:** eliminate dead local variables that are not referenced.
  • **Specific change:** in the instantiate: (creds) => { ... } block for the 'email' provider, delete line 231:
    • const connectionString = creds.clientId; // Reusing clientId field for connection string
  • Keep all functional logic unchanged (emailFromAddress, Resend(...), and sendEmail(...) remain as-is).
  • No import or dependency changes are required.

## Unused variable, import, function or class Unused variable connectionString. --- To fix this type of issue generally, remove variables/imports/functions that are declared but never used, unless they are required for side effects (which local const bindings are not). If a value is intentionally unused, either remove it or explicitly consume it in a meaningful way.

For this specific case in apps/web/src/auth.ts, inside the email provider instantiate block (around lines 230–233), remove the unused connectionString declaration and keep the emailFromAddress declaration and all existing logic unchanged. This preserves runtime behavior and satisfies the static analysis warning without introducing new dependencies or altering authentication flow.
